failure.deterministic_signature: fatal: detected dubious ownership in repository at '/data/project'
failure.submitted_operation_missing: normalize the fresh checkout's Git safe.directory state before editable installation

causal_interpretation.algorithm_implication: The in-session replay must reproduce Official checkout ownership semantics and return the deterministic bootstrap failure to the same Agent; additional package-selection rules do not address this failure.

deployment_completeness.reason: The program used real project and dependency installations, but Official failed before environment completion.
